question: What auspicious matter concerning time does the speaker now wish to hear, and what aspect of time is it said to concern?
premises: The speaker wishes to hear something now.
The object of hearing is the deception of time.
That matter is characterized as auspicious.
inference: Now the speaker wishes to hear the auspicious matter of the deception of time.
uncertainties: Whether vañcanaṃ is active deception or that by which time deceives remains open
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
